description_en: Queries the details of a specified scheduled virus scan policy
description_zh: 查询指定病毒定时扫描策略的详情
name: GetVirusScanScheduledStrategy

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the scheduled virus scan policy. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
[ListVirusScanScheduledStrategies](~~ListVirusScanScheduledStrategies~~): Lists scheduled virus scan policies.
[CreateVirusScanScheduledStrategy](~~CreateVirusScanScheduledStrategy~~): Creates a scheduled virus scan policy
parameters.help_zh:
病毒定时扫描策略ID。取值来源：
[ListVirusScanScheduledStrategies](~~ListVirusScanScheduledStrategies~~)：批量查询病毒定时扫描策略。
[CreateVirusScanScheduledStrategy](~~CreateVirusScanScheduledStrategy~~)：创建病毒定时扫描策略
parameters.name: strategy_id

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the policy was created, in the format of yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss in the UTC+8 time zone
CreateTime.description_zh: 策略创建时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，使用UTC+8时区

CustomMatchGroup.description_en: The effective scope specified by organizational structure
CustomMatchGroup.description_zh: 按组织架构指定的生效范围

Group.description_en: The collection of organizational structure nodes

items.description_en: The DN of the organizational structure node

HighRiskOperation.description_en:
The action to take on high-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantine quarantined file.
Notify: Only report an alert without taking action on quarantined file
HighRiskOperation.description_zh:
对高危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件

LastTriggerTime.description_en: The time when the policy last triggered a scan, in the format of yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss in the UTC+8 time zone. An empty string is returned if the policy has never been triggered
LastTriggerTime.description_zh: 策略最近一次触发扫描的时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，使用UTC+8时区。从未触发过时返回空字符串

LowRiskOperation.description_en:
The action to take on low-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantine quarantined file.
Notify: Only report an alert without taking action on quarantined file.
None: No action
LowRiskOperation.description_zh:
对低危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件。
None：不处理

MatchMode.description_en:
The matching method for the effective scope. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: Applies to all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
UserGroupNormal: Applies only to users in specified user groups
MatchMode.description_zh:
生效范围的匹配方式。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效。
UserGroupNormal：仅对指定用户组内的用户生效

MatchTargetIds.description_en: The collection of user group IDs within the effective scope. An empty list is returned when MatchMode is set to UserGroupAll
MatchTargetIds.description_zh: 生效的用户组ID集合。MatchMode取值为UserGroupAll时返回空列表

MaxCpuUsage.description_en: The maximum percentage of endpoint CPU usage allowed during the scan
MaxCpuUsage.description_zh: 扫描时占用终端CPU的百分比上限

MidRiskOperation.description_en:
The action to take on medium-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantine quarantined file.
Notify: Only report an alert without taking action on quarantined file
MidRiskOperation.description_zh:
对中危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件

PerformanceMode.description_en:
The scan performance schema pattern. Valid values:
SecurityFirst: Security first. The default CPU usage upper limit is 50%.
Balance: Balanced. The default CPU usage upper limit is 30%.
ExperienceFirst: Experience first. The default CPU usage upper limit is 15%
PerformanceMode.description_zh:
扫描性能模式。取值：
SecurityFirst：安全优先，CPU占用上限默认为50%。
Balance：均衡，CPU占用上限默认为30%。
ExperienceFirst：体验优先，CPU占用上限默认为15%

Priority.description_en: The policy priority. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Priority.description_zh: 策略优先级，数值越小优先级越高

ScanBeginTime.description_en: The start hour during which the scan can be triggered. The value is a whole hour number ranging from 0 to 23, inclusive. This field is not a timestamp
ScanBeginTime.description_zh: 允许触发扫描的起始小时，取整点小时数，取值范围：0~23，包含该小时。本字段不是时间戳

ScanEndTime.description_en: The end hour during which the scan can be triggered. The value is a whole hour number ranging from 1 to 24, exclusive of the specified hour, and must be greater than ScanBeginTime. The scan task generated by each trigger expires at this hour on the same day. This field is not a timestamp
ScanEndTime.description_zh: 允许触发扫描的结束小时，取整点小时数，取值范围：1~24，不包含该小时，且必须大于ScanBeginTime。每次触发生成的扫描任务在当天该整点失效。本字段不是时间戳

ScanFrequency.description_en:
The unit of the trigger cycle. Valid values:
day: By day.
week: By week
ScanFrequency.description_zh:
触发周期的单位。取值：
day：按天。
week：按周

ScanInterval.description_en: The interval number of the trigger cycle, which determines the trigger cycle together with ScanFrequency. For example, if ScanFrequency is set to week and ScanInterval is set to 1, the scan is triggered once a week
ScanInterval.description_zh: 触发周期的间隔数，与ScanFrequency共同决定触发周期。例如ScanFrequency取值为week、ScanInterval取值为1时，表示每周扫描一次

ScanMode.description_en:
The scan path scope. Valid values:
Quick: Quick scan. Only scans critical system directories and common risk locations.
Full: Full disk scan.
Custom: Custom path scan
ScanMode.description_zh:
扫描的路径范围。取值：
Quick：快速扫描，仅扫描系统关键目录与常见风险位置。
Full：全盘扫描。
Custom：自定义路径扫描

ScanPath.description_en: The collection of custom scan paths

items.description_en: The custom scan path. Supports Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, spaces, periods (.), colons (:), percent signs (%), forward slashes (/), backslashes (), underscores (_), parentheses, tildes (~), square brackets, and hyphens (-). Commas are not supported
items.description_zh: 自定义扫描路径。支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字及空格、半角句点（.）、冒号（:）、百分号（%）、正斜杠（/）、反斜杠（\）、下划线（_）、圆括号、波浪号（~）、方括号、连字符（-）。不支持逗号

ScanTargets.description_en: The collection of virus types to be handled in this scan
ScanTargets.description_zh: 本次扫描要处置的病毒类型集合

Backdoor: Backdoor program.
DDoS: DDoS Trojan.
Downloader: Downloader Trojan.
Engtest: DPI engine test program.
Hacktool: Hacker tool.
Trojan: Self-mutating Trojan.
Malbaseware: Contaminated base software.
MalScript: Malicious script.
Malware: Malicious program.
Miner: Mining programs.
Proxytool: Proxy tool.
RansomWare: Ransomware.
RiskWare: Risky software.
Rootkit: Kernel-hidden program.
Stealer: Credential-stealing tool.
Scanner: Scanner.
Suspicious: Suspicious program.
Virus: File-infecting virus.
WebShell: Web shell.
Worm: Worms.
BlackList: File that hit the blacklist.
Exp: Vulnerability exploits program.
Patcher: Cracking program.
Gametool: Private server tool.
AdWare: Adware.
Maldoc: Malicious document
items.description_zh:
病毒类型。取值：
Backdoor：后门程序。
DDoS：DDoS木马。
Downloader：下载器木马。
Engtest：引擎测试程序。
Hacktool：黑客工具。
Trojan：自变异木马。
Malbaseware：被污染的基础软件。
MalScript：恶意脚本。
Malware：恶意程序。
Miner：挖矿程序。
Proxytool：代理工具。
RansomWare：勒索病毒。
RiskWare：风险软件。
Rootkit：内核隐藏程序。
Stealer：窃密工具。
Scanner：扫描器。
Suspicious：可疑程序。
Virus：感染型病毒。
WebShell：网站后门。
Worm：蠕虫病毒。
BlackList：命中黑名单的文件。
Exp：漏洞利用程序。
Patcher：破解程序。
Gametool：私服工具。
AdWare：广告程序。
Maldoc：恶意文档

Status.description_en:
The enabled status. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
Status.description_zh:
启用状态。取值：
Enabled：已启用。
Disabled：已停用

StrategyDescription.example: 每周日凌晨对研发部门终端全盘扫描

StrategyId.description_en: The ID of the scheduled virus scan policy

Whitelist.description_en: The list of exempted users. Users in this list are excluded from the scan policy. An empty list is returned if no exemptions are configured
Whitelist.description_zh: 例外用户名单，名单内的用户不执行该策略的扫描。未配置时返回空列表

items.description_en: The username. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and supports Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), asterisks (*), hyphens (-), at signs (@), spaces, middle dots (·), and parentheses
items.description_zh: 用户名。长度不超过128个字符，支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字及半角句点（.）、下划线（_）、星号（*）、连字符（-）、@、空格、中间点（·）、圆括号
